newsitem.title: USA: Home Depot, Dayton Hudson profits rise; stocks jump.
newsitem.headline: Home Depot, Dayton Hudson profits rise; stocks jump.

text.p: Retailers Home Depot Inc. and Dayton Hudson Corp. reported strong first-quarter earnings Tuesday, and the upbeat results sparked a rally in their stock prices.

Home Depot, the nation's largest home improvement retailer, said it earned $258.8 million, or 53 cents a share, in its fiscal first quarter ended on May 4, compared with year-ago profits of $195.0 million, or 41 cents a share.
Revenues for the Altlanta-based chain also were up sharply at $5.65 billion from $4.36 billion.

Dayton Hudson, which operates the Target discount store chain, general merchandise and traditional department stores, reported first-quarter earnings of $105 million, or 45 cents a share, following a one-time charge of $21 million for debt redemption. That compared with $41 million, or 17 cents a share, a year earlier.
Revenues for the Minneapolis-based company rose to $5.89 billion from $5.38 billion.
Following the news, Home Depot's stock jumped $1.25 to a 52-week high of $61 on the New York Stock Exchange and Dayton Hudson hit a new high of $49, up $2 from Monday's close on the NYSE.

"Fiscal 1997 is off to a very strong start with our record earnings for the first quarter," said Bernard Marcus, chief executive officer of Home Depot. "We are particularly pleased with strong sales trends in the first quarter, which reflect an earlier start to the spring season versus last year," he said.

In the first quarter, Home Depot said it opened 24 new stores, bringing the total to 536 stores, including 503 Home Depot stores and 5 EXPO Design Centres in the United States and 28 Home Depot stores in Canada.

Bob Ulrich, Dayton Hudson chairman and chief executive officer, said the company was also pleased with its results, especially Target's strong performance. "Each of our divisions contributed to our improvement in earnings this quarter," Ulrich said.

Dayton Hudson opened 17 Target Stores and one Mervyn's store during the quarter. At the end of the quarter, the company operated 1,092 stores in 39 states, including 752 Target stores, 276 Mervyn's stores and 64 Department Stores.
